ead:bioghist.ead:head: Biographical Note
ead:bioghist.ead:p: Becker, Johann Philipp. Born in Frankenthal, Pfalz 1809, died in Geneva 1886; broom maker, later cigar manufacturer and journalist; fled for political reasons to Switzerland in 1838; became a Swiss citizen and participated in the Sonderbund war; was in command of a unit of a revolutionary German army in Southern Germany 1848-1849; member of the Allgemeine Deutsche Arbeiterverein (ADAV) from 1863; participated in the founding of the International Working Men's Association (IWMA) in 1864 and became head of the section for the German speaking countries; one of the founders of the German Sozialdemokratische Arbeiterpartei (SDAP) in 1869; editor of Der Vorbote 1866-1871 and of Le Précurseur 1877-1882.

ead:acqinfo.ead:head: Acquisition
ead:acqinfo.ead:p: These papers were originally part of the historical party-archives of the SPD. The IISH acquired this collection from the SPD in exile in 1938 with financial support of the Centrale Arbeiders-Verzekerings- en Deposito-Bank (the Centrale). The collection, including the papers of Karl Marx, Friedrich Engels, August Bebel, Eduard Bernstein, and Wilhelm Liebknecht, was mentioned in the Annual Report of 1938 (p. 37-42). The contract was signed 19 May 1938.

ead:scopecontent.ead:head: Content
ead:scopecontent.ead:p: Letters from Michail Bakunin 1868-1870, Sophie von Hatzfeldt 1864-1865, Georg Herwegh 1865-1871, Hermann Jung 1868-1873, Ferdinand Lassalle 1863-1864, Wilhelm Liebknecht 1866-1881 and n.d., Julius Motteler 1877-1884, Theodor Remy 1861-1875, Friedrich A. Sorge 1867-1884, Paul Stumpf 1866-1882 and others; some original letters by J.P. Becker; manuscripts; handwritten statutes and rules, proceedings and resolutions; deeds; manuscripts by others; some printed material.

ead:arrangement.ead:head: Arrangement
ead:arrangement.ead:p: A first inventory -made in the 1960s- has been updated and edited by Ursula Balzer in 2008; a number of documents which were overlooked originally have been included in it (see inv. nos. add. 1-65) and the packaging has been renewed.
